blocks.text: Oxides oxygen ke doosre anasir se reaction se bane do-juzi (binary) compounds hain. Un ki khusoosiyat se inhen neutral, basic, amphoteric ya acidic mein baanta jata hai.

items: Basic oxides: woh oxide jo pani se mil kar alkali deta hai. Metals oxygen se react kar ke basic oxides dete hain, jo aam taur par ionic hain; groups 1 aur 2 inhen banate hain, maslan Na2O, CaO aur BaO. Na2O(s) + H2O(l) se 2NaOH(aq); CaO(s) + H2O(l) se Ca(OH)2(aq). Group 2 ke hydroxides ki hal-pazeeri group mein neeche barhti hai, to un ki alkalinity bhi group mein neeche barhti hai.

Amphoteric oxides: woh oxides jo acids aur bases dono se react karte hain, halaat ke mutabiq acid ya base ka rawaiya rakhte hue. Aluminium oxide (Al2O3) pani mein na-hal-pazeer hai magar hydrochloric acid se react kar ke aluminium chloride aur pani, aur sodium hydroxide se react kar ke sodium aluminate aur pani banata hai: Al2O3(s) + 6HCl(aq) se 2AlCl3(s) + 3H2O(l); Al2O3(s) + 2NaOH(aq) se Na2Al2O4(s) + H2O(l).

Acidic oxides: woh oxide jo pani se mil kar acid deta hai. Non-metals oxygen se react kar ke covalent bonds se jure acidic oxides banate hain; silicon dioxide acidic gina jata hai kyunke yeh bases se react karta hai. Period 3 ke acidic oxides P2O3, P2O5, SO3 aur SO2 hain. Pani se: P2O3(s) + H2O(l) se H3PO3(aq); SO2(g) + H2O(l) se H2SO3(aq). Bases se: SiO2(s) + 2NaOH(aq) se Na2SiO3(aq) + H2O(l); P2O3(s) + 6NaOH(aq) se 2Na3PO3(aq) + 3H2O(l); SO2(g) + 2NaOH(aq) se Na2SO3(aq) + H2O(l).

blocks.prompt: Zinc oxide hydrochloric acid se ZnCl2 aur sodium hydroxide se Na2ZnO2 deta hai. Muadlat likhein aur oxide ki darja-bandi karein.
blocks.explanation: ZnO + 2HCl se ZnCl2 + H2O, aur ZnO + 2NaOH se Na2ZnO2 + H2O. Chunke yeh acid aur base dono se react karta hai, zinc oxide aluminium oxide ki tarah amphoteric hai.

items: Basic oxides (groups 1 aur 2, ionic) pani se alkalis dete hain; group 2 ki alkalinity group mein neeche barhti hai. Amphoteric Al2O3 HCl aur NaOH dono se react karta hai. Acidic oxides (covalent non-metal oxides SiO2, P2O3, P2O5, SO2, SO3) pani se acids ya bases se namak dete hain.
